name: Chicago Public Library teen assistantships (Teen Best Reads, Teen Gamer's Guild, Teen Media Lab)
org: Chicago Public Library with After School Matters
what_you_do: These are paid teen assistantships at the library. You pick and promote the year's best teen books. Or you plan a free gaming convention. Or you make social media content in YOUmedia. Teens meet weekly or monthly and finish projects.
who_can_apply: Must live in the City of Chicago and attend a Chicago high school. Ages 14 to 19 on the start date of Jan 9, 2027. Teen Best Reads and Teen Media Lab are open to current 9th, 10th and 11th graders.
pay_detail: These are stipend assistantships. The amounts are not stated on the page we read, so check the library's page.
duration: Starts Jan 9, 2027. Gamer's Guild to June 10; Media Lab Jan to June 22 and Sept 7 to Dec 14; Best Reads to Dec 14.
deadline_text: Applications open Monday Oct 19, 2026 and close Sunday Nov 8, 2026.
how_to_apply: Apply on the Chicago Public Library application form (not the After School Matters site). Answer the open-ended questions carefully; they decide who is interviewed. Virtual interview in Microsoft Teams for each program. Apply to as many as you like but accept one.
notes: You enroll with After School Matters during the first month, which needs a Social Security Number and parent or guardian information. Questions: teenservices@chipublib.org. Gamer's Guild sub-guilds meet at different library branches.
